description: Unofficial Usul fan-art animated companion inspired by the yellow Neopets catalogue form. Nine original states include tail-supported paper smoothing and recovery, arranging two oversized toy nuts, attentive ear and heel bobs, squirrel-like movement in three directions, and a small hop. Simplified cel sprites and gentle toy-prop choreography are original adaptations, not official Neopets animation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
